steps.what: Read the development plan and the last environmental impact note
Walk the site and note pollution or visible degradation
Write each limit as pollutant, unit, threshold and parcel
Compare each reading with her threshold and changed hectares
Judge whether a flag is real impact from development activities
Monitor what the visit showed and tell the project lead

tasks.design: She still walks the site and decides whether a change is harm. The work removed is comparing each lab reading with the threshold she wrote, and subtracting the last hectare area from the new area on a rerunnable pass over the satellite cube. Filing the judgement in {DOCS} is not counted.
tasks.previous_blocker: Telling harm from a sensor fault needs the site, which a threshold comparison cannot visit.
tasks.enabler_now: Once she writes pollutant, unit, threshold and parcel as fields, those numbers can be compared by a fixed rule.
tasks.still_hard: The site walk, and deciding that a flag is real degradation.
tasks.human_edge: She can tell a sensor fault from harm because she saw the ground.

ambition.what: She checks every new lab batch against her thresholds, including batches that arrive between site visits.

tasks.altitude: Her week still holds the site walk and the harm judgement. Only the hand comparison of readings and hectares leaves.

reach.task: Retest a parcel she has already limited.
reach.learn: Read pollutant, unit, threshold and parcel from her limit row instead of rebuilding it.

evidence.claim: Comparing a reading with a threshold, and subtracting one parcel area from another, is arithmetic once she has written those fields. The site walk and the harm judgement are not that arithmetic.
Copernicus openEO runs a Python or R script again over a Sentinel datacube to make a land cover map.
Reports and analysis are not Annex III. Point 2 covers AI used as a safety component in water, gas, heating or electricity supply.
Comparing a reading with a threshold she wrote is not an AI safety component of water, gas, heating or electricity supply.

assumptions: The producer of the limit row is the industrial ecologist in s3. Fields are pollutant name, unit, numeric threshold and parcel id. Readings come from the laboratory file. A reading with no unit is skipped. Hectares need a scene id, the same parcel id and a class area. If there is no new scene, the hectare line does not run.
The work removed is that comparison and that subtraction. There is no second system and no send. A later paste of the judgement into the note in {DOCS} is the same note, not removed work.
The site walk and the harm judgement stay at full time. She keeps the thresholds when a permit limit changes. That upkeep is her time.
unknowns: Whether this site's parcels have a repeat satellite scene, or only the walk.
Whether any monitored activity is a safety component in water, gas, heating or electricity supply.
research_questions: For the last six monitoring rounds, how many had both a lab batch and a new scene for the same parcel?

already_counted.description: Reading the plan, walking the site, writing limits, judging flags and briefing the project lead stay in s1, s2, s3, s5 and s6.

incremental.description: She updates threshold numbers when a permit limit changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A month with a lab batch and a new scene for the same parcel is the high case. A month with neither leaves the walk and the judgement, and the comparison does not run.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read lab information about pollutants and industrial processes
Choose fields for energy alternatives and natural environments
Copy related ecological change values from the laboratory export
Check copied values against the laboratory file she was given
Build the checked rows into the pollutant store colleagues query
Maintain databases of other factors that have no lab file
Tell a colleague which factor applies to a process

tasks.design: She still chooses the fields and still types factors that arrive with no laboratory export. The work removed is copying values from that export onto her column map, then posting the checked batch into the {SPREADSHEET} pollutant store, which is a second entry. A further save of the same batch inside that store is not counted.
tasks.previous_blocker: Laboratory exports and her store used different headers, so each value was re-typed.
tasks.enabler_now: A column map with units lets a copy run, and she can check a sample before the batch is posted.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding which factor fits when two processes share a pollutant.
tasks.human_edge: She knows which factor belongs to this process. The copy does not.

ambition.what: She sees a factor whose source year is older than the age she set, each time the store is opened.

tasks.altitude: Her week still holds the field choice and the factors with no file. Copying matched laboratory rows, and the post of the checked batch, leave when an export arrives.

reach.task: Look up a pollutant factor she has already stored.
reach.learn: Read process, pollutant, unit and source year from the store instead of asking her to retype them.

evidence.claim: Copying a laboratory value into a second store is re-typing. A column map can copy it when the header and the unit match. Choosing which factor fits a process is not that copy.
An Irish ISO 17025 water lab replaced paper and Excel-based processes.
Audit trails that name staff are personal data. Article 27(1)(k) requires consent, and (l) applies if the trail is used to check performance.
Using an import log to score the ecologist's work would be a performance check. Recording only the batch id is not that score.

assumptions: The producer of the column map is the industrial ecologist in s2. Fields are source header, store field and unit. The laboratory export is produced by laboratory staff, and that time is not in her baseline. If a header has no map row, the value stays for her to type in s6.

The work removed in s3 is copying values off the laboratory export. The work removed in s5 is posting that checked batch into the pollutant workbook, a second entry. A further save inside the workbook is not counted. If the export is already that workbook, neither cut applies.
The Irish lab case has no measured baseline in the digest, so her hours are not taken from it.
She keeps the column map when a laboratory header changes. That upkeep is her time, not system runtime. The import log stores batch id and date, not a score of her work.
unknowns: Whether the laboratory export is a separate file or already the workbook she maintains.
Whether the import log will name her, which would bring the works-council consent rule into the build.
research_questions: For the last ten laboratory files, how many used headers that were not already the pollutant workbook?

already_counted.description: Reading sources, choosing fields, checking a sample, typing factors with no file, and answering colleagues stay in s1, s2, s4, s6 and s7.

incremental.description: She updates the column map when a laboratory header or unit changes.

approvals.approved_version: The batch of pollutant rows she checked against the laboratory export

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A year when the laboratory export is a different file from the workbook, and most rows match the map, is the high case. A year when the export is already the workbook is zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read studies and site notes on human behavior
Decide which human behavior can affect the environment
Tabulate counts of that behavior and the environmental changes
Divide those counts by the weeks she named in the table
Perform analyses that determine how people are affected
Explain the finding to the project team in the room

tasks.design: She still chooses the behavior mechanism and writes the analysis. The work removed is dividing the counts she tabulated by the weeks she named. No send and no second entry is counted.
tasks.previous_blocker: How behavior and the environment affect each other is not a division.
tasks.enabler_now: Once she writes a count and a week count, the rate is arithmetic.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing the mechanism, and writing what the rate means for people.
tasks.human_edge: She judges the mechanism. The rate does not say whether it matters.
tasks.altitude: Her week still holds the mechanism choice, the written analysis and the briefing. Only the division of counts she already tabulated leaves.

reach.task: Reuse a count table she has already defined.
reach.learn: Read behavior name, count and weeks from her table instead of recoding the same notes.

evidence.claim: A rate from counts and weeks she tabulated is division. Judging how behavior and the environment affect each other is not that division.

assumptions: The producer of the count table is the industrial ecologist in s3. Fields are behavior name, count, weeks and the environmental measure. If the measure is not a number, s4 does not run and she writes the analysis without a rate.

The work removed is that division. Writing the analysis and briefing the team stay at full time. There is no second system and no send. Pasting the rate into the analysis note in {DOCS} is the same note, not removed work.
unknowns: Whether her current analyses rest on counts, or only on qualitative notes with nothing to divide.
research_questions: For the last five analyses, how many had a numeric count and a week window, and how many were qualitative only?

already_counted.description: Reading, choosing the behavior, tabulating counts, writing the analysis and briefing the team stay in s1, s2, s3, s5 and s6.

incremental.description: She keeps the behavior names and the week window the division uses.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A month where her counts and weeks are numbers is the high case. A month of qualitative notes only does not run the division.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read industrial production practices and environmental damage notes
Choose methods to protect the environment or minimize damage
Draft each recommendation sentence from her method list

loop.purpose: Turn her method list into recommendation sentences and nothing else.
loop.input: The method list from s2: method name, production practice, and the damage change she expects.
loop.output: Recommendation sentences that name only those methods.
loop.check: Every method name in a sentence is on her list. A sentence that adds a method, or a number absent from the list, fails.
loop.stop: Any failed sentence, or an empty list.
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed template cannot tell whether a sentence recommends a method she did not choose.

steps.what: Reject a sentence that adds a method she did not list
Recommend the checked methods at the production meeting

tasks.design: She still chooses the methods and recommends them in the production meeting. The work removed is assembling recommendation sentences from the method list she wrote. The meeting is spoken advice to colleagues, not a transport that leaves, and a save of the note in {DOCS} is not counted.
tasks.previous_blocker: A generated sentence can name a method she would not sign.
tasks.enabler_now: A list she wrote lets each sentence be checked for a method she did not choose.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing the methods, and standing by them with the production team.
tasks.human_edge: She is accountable for the method the plant will use.
tasks.altitude: Her week still holds the method choice and the production meeting. Only sentence assembly from a list she wrote leaves.

reach.task: Apply a protection method she has already listed.
reach.learn: Read the method name and the practice from her list instead of inferring one from memory of the meeting.

evidence.claim: A draft can be limited to method names she listed, and she can reject a sentence that adds a method or a number.
In 84 generated literature reviews, 55% of GPT-3.5 references and 18% of GPT-4 references were fabricated.
Article 50(4) requires disclosure of AI text informing the public, such as weather or climate briefs, unless a person reviews it under editorial responsibility.
A recommendation spoken in an internal production meeting is not a public climate brief.

assumptions: The producer of the method list is the industrial ecologist in s2. Fields are method name, production practice and the damage change she expects. An empty list stops the draft.

The work removed is assembling those sentences. The fabrication rates in the literature-review study are not her error rate. The meeting stays at full time. There is no portal. A save of the note in {DOCS} is not counted.
If she later publishes the text for the public, disclosure applies. This design does not do that publish.
She keeps the method names current. That upkeep is her time.
unknowns: Whether any recommendation from this role is published as a public brief, rather than spoken inside the plant.
research_questions: For the last five recommendations, how many started from a written method list, and how many were spoken with no list?

already_counted.description: Reading practices, choosing methods, rejecting added methods and speaking at the meeting stay in s1, s2, s4 and s5.

incremental.description: She keeps the method names and the damage change she expects on the list.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A month where she has a written method list and keeps most drafted sentences is the high case. A month where she speaks with no list does not run the draft.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: She still walks the site, decides whether a flag is harm, chooses database fields, judges how behavior and the environment affect each other, and picks the protection methods she will defend. Hand comparison of readings and hectares, copying laboratory values into the pollutant store, dividing counts she tabulated, and assembling recommendation sentences from her own list leave the week when those steps apply.
reach: An environmental science technician can reuse her limit row, pollutant, unit, threshold and parcel, instead of rebuilding it.
A production supervisor can apply a method she listed instead of inferring one from memory of the meeting.
skills_to_grow: Write a limit as pollutant, unit, threshold and parcel before any flag is raised.
Reject a recommendation sentence that names a method missing from her list.
role.ambitious_version: No unattended agent decides that a flag is harm, picks a protection method, or files a permit.
